title: Garbage collection pass
fix_rationale: GC hitches are reliably eliminated or reduced by pooling objects, reducing UObject churn, and spreading destruction across frames.
evidence_template: {timer} took {ms} ms (normally {baseline_ms} ms), explaining {share}% of the excess frame time{periodic_clause}.

fixes.text: Pool and reuse actors and components instead of spawning and destroying them dynamically.
Avoid mass object destruction in a single frame (e.g. at wave ends or inventory clears); distribute over multiple ticks.
Tune garbage collection cvars for your engine version.
Audit UObject count using 'obj list' to find reference leaks or excessive Blueprint component instances.

verify: Re-capture a trace under identical gameplay conditions and verify that CollectGarbage time decreases below 5 ms or no longer spikes.
caveats: Editor sessions keep many extra editor objects alive in memory; GC execution cost is higher in editor than in packaged builds.
